title: Choose Maximum Ads
real_world_story: An advertising platform has a fixed amount of available display time and wants to show as many advertisements as possible. Each advertisement requires a different amount of time, and all advertisements provide equal priority.

real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Choosing shorter advertisements first to maximize the number displayed

problem_statement: Given N advertisements with different durations and a total available time T, determine the maximum number of advertisements that can be displayed without exceeding T.
task: Find the maximum number of advertisements that fit within the available display time.
input_format: The first line contains two integers N and T. The second line contains N integers representing advertisement durations.
output_format: Print the maximum number of advertisements that can be displayed.

examples.explanation: The four shortest advertisements have durations 2, 3, 4, and 5. Their total duration is 14, while adding the next shortest advertisement would exceed 15.
The two shortest advertisements require 2 + 4 = 6 units of time. Adding the next advertisement would require 12 units, exceeding the limit.

expected_algorithm.name: Greedy
expected_algorithm.reason: Selecting the shortest advertisements first leaves the most available time and therefore maximizes the number of advertisements displayed.

hint: Keep selecting advertisements while the total duration does not exceed T.
real_world_takeaway: A greedy strategy can maximize the number of advertisements displayed when every advertisement has equal priority.
